the influences of bFGF (basic fibroblast growth factor) and EGF (epidermal growth factor) on the proliferation and the differentiation of endogenous NSCs (neural stem cells) in the subventricular zone (SVZ) and the rostral migratory stream (RMS) of human cerebral infarction.

the influences of basic fibroblast growth factor (bFGF) and epidermal growth factor (EGF) on neural stem cells (NSCs) in the subventricular zone (SVZ) and the subgranular zone (SGZ) in the cerebral cortex after ischemic stroke.
the influences of bFGF, EGF on the differentiation of neural stem cells and their effects on the proliferation of neural stem cells after the cerebral infarction.

the results indicate that bFGF and/or EGF can enhance the proliferation and differentiation capacity of endogenous neural precursor cells (NPCs) in the ischemic penumbra of human cerebral infarction.
